newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria two-year T-note issue sells only one pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria two-year T-note issue sells only one pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry offer of 200 million levs of two-year floater coupon T-notes was just one percent sold at 82 levs per 100 levs par value, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry for the Friday auction.
The semi-annual coupon was set equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
One financial institution took part in the auction, the BNB said.
The BNB did not say what the yield of the paper was. Finance Ministry officials were not available for comment.
